senses.gloss: (= נונו = נענע, v. preced.; cmp. צִוְצֵי, s. v. צָוַץ) to be tender, delicate.
to become delicate, be failing, to fall away.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 91a:13">B. Kam. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>אמדוהו והיה מִתְנַוְנֶה והולך</he> (Ms. M. <he>מִתְנַוְונֶה</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>מִתְנַוֶּה</he>) if the experts declared his injuries as curable (and the court assessed the damages accordingly), but he continues to be falling away.
<cite ref="Chullin 57b:13">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>מִתְנַוְונָה והולכת</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:9">Tosef. ib. III, 9</cite> <he>מכחשת</he>) if the animal loses flesh, opp. <he>משבחת</he>.

<cite ref="Sotah 26a:14">Ib. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>במתנונה דרך איברים</he> when she is ailing all over the body (not suffering locally as predicted for the faithless woman, <cite ref="Numbers 5:27">Num. V, 27</cite>); Y. ib. III, 19ᵃ bot. <he>המִתְנַוָּוה</he>.
